data.exact_reserve_text:
There was limited claims movement on our closed years (2009-2019), primarily from improvements on the 2019 year of account offset by deterioration on the 2017 year. The result on the closed years for financial year 2022 was a profit of $2.7m.

In the financial year there was prior accident year favourable development of claims incurred of $6.3 million (2021: $5.3 million adverse).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Losses arising from COVID-19 (net losses before LPT of $121.5m) and associated reinsurance costs contributed to the 2020 underwriting year loss; LPT agreement ceded these losses to Berkley Insurance Company removing net impact on the Syndicate.
Catastrophe losses from Hurricane Laura contributed to continuing favourable claims development supporting a positive outturn on 2021.
Winter storms supported favourable claims development and a positive outturn on the 2021 underwriting year.

named_events.loss_description: Significant losses from catastrophes, in particular Hurricane Ian (net loss of $16.8m) have contributed to a loss to date on the year.
Continuing favourable claims development in particular on catastrophe losses from Hurricane Laura and winter storms has supported a positive outturn on the year.

The 2020 underwriting year was affected by losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic; particularly the Contingency class. Losses from the Contingency class are capped through the LPT agreement entered into with Berkley Insurance Company.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross prior-year claim reserves showed a net strengthening in 2022, driven by upward revisions primarily in older underwriting years (notably movements including the 2017 and 2020 cohorts), resulting in an estimated gross adverse development of approximately $45.5m (8.1% of opening gross claims outstanding). This contrasted with limited releases on closed years (2009-2019) - a net profit on those closed years of $2.7m - with improvements noted on the 2019 year partially offset by deterioration on the 2017 year. COVID-19 related losses were managed via a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) which removed the net impact to the Syndicate, while named catastrophe events (e.g. Hurricane Ian) materially affected current-year results.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Primary currency of the report is USD. Opening reserves taken from Balance Sheet (claims outstanding, prior year comparative). Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims by underwriting year) because no explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior years' figure was provided. The triangle is presented in thousands (USD). The triangle includes the 2020 vintage which is volatile due to COVID-19; the LPT arrangement for COVID-19 is noted in the report and may distort comparisons. Some narrative figures (e.g. prior accident year favourable development of $6.3m) are P&L 'claims incurred' metrics and were not used as the primary gross PYD source per instructions.
